      "source": [
        "!pip install -q mne\n",
        "\n",
        "import os, random, numpy as np, torch, torch.nn as nn, torch.nn.functional as F\n",
        "import mne, matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from scipy import stats\n",
        "from scipy.signal import welch\n",
        "from mne.datasets import eegbci\n",
        "from mne.io import concatenate_raws, read_raw_edf\n",
        "from mne.decoding import CSP\n",
        "from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression\n",
        "from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis as LDA\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score\n",
        "\n",
        "mne.set_log_level(\"ERROR\")\n",
        "device = \"cuda\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\"\n",
        "print(\"device:\", device)\n",
        "\n",
        "TRAIN_SUBJ = list(range(1, 36))\n",
        "VAL_SUBJ   = list(range(36, 41))\n",
        "TEST_SUBJ  = list(range(41, 51))\n",
        "SEEDS = [0, 1, 2]\n",
        "\n",
        "def set_seed(s):\n",
        "    random.seed(s); np.random.seed(s)\n",
        "    torch.manual_seed(s); torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(s)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "2: Load data (cached)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "1rILu42kLAqS"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "RUNS = [4, 8, 12]   # imagined left vs right fist\n",
        "\n",
        "def load_subject(s):\n",
        "    files = eegbci.load_data(s, RUNS, verbose=False)\n",
        "    raw = concatenate_raws([read_raw_edf(f, preload=True) for f in files])\n",
        "    eegbci.standardize(raw)\n",
        "    raw.set_montage(\"standard_1005\")\n",
        "    raw.filter(8., 30., fir_design=\"firwin\")\n",
        "    events, _ = mne.events_from_annotations(raw, event_id=dict(T1=2, T2=3))\n",
        "    picks = mne.pick_types(raw.info, eeg=True)\n",
        "    ep = mne.Epochs(raw, events, dict(left=2, right=3), tmin=0.5, tmax=3.5,\n",
        "                    picks=picks, baseline=None, preload=True)\n",
        "    X = ep.get_data()[:, :, :480]\n",
        "    X = X - X.mean(-1, keepdims=True)\n",
        "    X = X / (X.std(axis=(1, 2), keepdims=True) + 1e-8)   # global scale per trial\n",
        "    y = (ep.events[:, -1] - 2).astype(\"int64\")            # 0=left, 1=right\n",
        "    return X.astype(\"float32\"), y, ep.ch_names\n",
        "\n",
        "CACHE = \"eeg_cache.npz\"\n",
        "if os.path.exists(CACHE):\n",
        "    d = np.load(CACHE, allow_pickle=True)\n",
        "    X, y, g, ch = d[\"X\"], d[\"y\"], d[\"g\"], list(d[\"ch\"])\n",
        "else:\n",
        "    Xs, ys, gs = [], [], []\n",
        "    for s in range(1, 51):\n",
        "        try:\n",
        "            Xi, yi, ch = load_subject(s)\n",
        "            Xs.append(Xi); ys.append(yi); gs.append(np.full(len(yi), s))\n",
        "        except Exception as e:\n",
        "            print(\"skip subject\", s, e)\n",
        "    X, y, g = np.concatenate(Xs), np.concatenate(ys), np.concatenate(gs)\n",
        "    np.savez(CACHE, X=X, y=y, g=g, ch=np.array(ch))\n",
        "\n",
        "tr, va, te = np.isin(g, TRAIN_SUBJ), np.isin(g, VAL_SUBJ), np.isin(g, TEST_SUBJ)\n",
        "Xtr, ytr, Xva, yva, Xte, yte, gte = X[tr], y[tr], X[va], y[va], X[te], y[te], g[te]\n",
        "print(X.shape, \"| train\", Xtr.shape[0], \"val\", Xva.shape[0], \"test\", Xte.shape[0])"
      ],

        "3: Classical baselines and the within-subject comparison\n",
        "python"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "a7qbspzpLSYs"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "res = {}\n",
        "\n",
        "# Baseline 1: log band-power features + logistic regression\n",
        "bp = lambda A: np.log(A.var(-1))\n",
        "clf = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000))\n",
        "clf.fit(bp(Xtr), ytr)\n",
        "res[\"Band-power + LogReg | cross-subject\"] = [clf.score(bp(Xte), yte)]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Baseline 2: CSP + LDA, the classic BCI method\n",
        "csp_lda = lambda: make_pipeline(CSP(n_components=6, reg=\"ledoit_wolf\", log=True), LDA())\n",
        "m = csp_lda().fit(Xtr.astype(\"float64\"), ytr)\n",
        "res[\"CSP + LDA | cross-subject\"] = [m.score(Xte.astype(\"float64\"), yte)]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Same method, trained and tested within each person (5-fold CV)\n",
        "within = {}\n",
        "for s in TEST_SUBJ:\n",
        "    k = gte == s\n",
        "    cv = StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0)\n",
        "    within[s] = cross_val_score(csp_lda(), Xte[k].astype(\"float64\"), yte[k], cv=cv).mean()\n",
        "res[\"CSP + LDA | within-subject (5-fold CV)\"] = [np.mean(list(within.values()))]\n",
        "\n",
        "for k, v in res.items():\n",
        "    print(f\"{k:45s} {100*np.mean(v):.1f}%\")"

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "4: EEGNet and the training function"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "SqRQsz_2LeaA"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "class EEGNet(nn.Module):\n",
        "    def __init__(self, chans=64, samples=480, classes=2, F1=8, D=2, F2=16, drop=0.5):\n",
        "        super().__init__()\n",
        "        self.b1 = nn.Sequential(\n",
        "            nn.Conv2d(1, F1, (1, 64), padding=(0, 32), bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(F1),\n",
        "            nn.Conv2d(F1, F1*D, (chans, 1), groups=F1, bias=False),\n",
        "            nn.BatchNorm2d(F1*D), nn.ELU(), nn.AvgPool2d((1, 4)), nn.Dropout(drop))\n",
        "        self.b2 = nn.Sequential(\n",
        "            nn.Conv2d(F1*D, F1*D, (1, 16), padding=(0, 8), groups=F1*D, bias=False),\n",
        "            nn.Conv2d(F1*D, F2, 1, bias=False), nn.BatchNorm2d(F2), nn.ELU(),\n",
        "            nn.AvgPool2d((1, 8)), nn.Dropout(drop))\n",
        "        with torch.no_grad():\n",
        "            n = self.b2(self.b1(torch.zeros(1, 1, chans, samples))).numel()\n",
        "        self.fc = nn.Linear(n, classes)\n",
        "    def forward(self, x):\n",
        "        return self.fc(self.b2(self.b1(x.unsqueeze(1))).flatten(1))\n",
        "\n",
        "@torch.no_grad()\n",
        "def predict(m, A):\n",
        "    m.eval(); out = []\n",
        "    for i in range(0, len(A), 256):\n",
        "        out.append(m(torch.tensor(A[i:i+256], device=device)).argmax(1).cpu())\n",
        "    return torch.cat(out).numpy()\n",
        "\n",
        "def augment(x):\n",
        "    x = x + 0.1 * torch.randn_like(x)                          # noise\n",
        "    x = torch.roll(x, int(np.random.randint(-16, 17)), dims=-1)  # time shift\n",
        "    keep = (torch.rand(x.shape[0], x.shape[1], 1, device=x.device) > 0.1).float()\n",
        "    return x * keep                                            # channel dropout\n",
        "\n",
        "def run(Xa, ya, Xv, yv, Xt, yt, seed=0, aug=False, epochs=40, bs=64):\n",
        "    set_seed(seed)\n",
        "    m = EEGNet().to(device)\n",
        "    opt = torch.optim.Adam(m.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-3)\n",
        "    XT, YT = torch.tensor(Xa, device=device), torch.tensor(ya, device=device)\n",
        "    best_val, best_state = -1, None\n",
        "    for ep in range(epochs):\n",
        "        m.train(); perm = torch.randperm(len(XT), device=device)\n",
        "        for i in range(0, len(XT), bs):\n",
        "            idx = perm[i:i+bs]; xb, yb = XT[idx], YT[idx]\n",
        "            if aug: xb = augment(xb)\n",
        "            opt.zero_grad(); F.cross_entropy(m(xb), yb).backward(); opt.step()\n",
        "        v = (predict(m, Xv) == yv).mean()\n",
        "        if v > best_val:\n",
        "            best_val = v\n",
        "            best_state = {k: t.clone() for k, t in m.state_dict().items()}\n",
        "    m.load_state_dict(best_state)            # model chosen on VALIDATION, not test\n",
        "    return m, best_val, (predict(m, Xt) == yt).mean()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "Ew79DhG-Lk1_"
      },
      "execution_count": 5,
      "outputs": []
    },

        "    accs = []\n",
        "    for s in SEEDS:\n",
        "        m, v, t = run(Xtr, ytr, Xva, yva, Xte, yte, seed=s, aug=aug)\n",
        "        models[(name, s)] = m; accs.append(t)\n",
        "        print(f\"{name} seed {s}: val {v:.3f} test {t:.3f}\")\n",

        "c3, c4 = ch.index(\"C3\"), ch.index(\"C4\")\n",
        "LI = np.log(Pmu[:, c4]) - np.log(Pmu[:, c3])     # lateralization index\n",
        "\n",
        "d = np.array([LI[(g == s) & (y == 1)].mean() - LI[(g == s) & (y == 0)].mean()\n",
        "              for s in np.unique(g)])             # right minus left, per subject\n",
        "t, pval = stats.ttest_1samp(d, 0)\n",
        "print(f\"Right-minus-left lateralization: mean {d.mean():.3f}, \"\n",
        "      f\"t={t:.2f}, p={pval:.4f}, n={len(d)} subjects\")\n",
        "print(f\"{(d > 0).sum()}/{len(d)} subjects show the expected direction\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.hist(d, bins=15); plt.axvline(0, color=\"k\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Right-minus-left lateralization index (per subject)\")\n",
